## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change (requires a `!` or `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer in the commit message)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other (refactor, tests, CI, chore, …)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (Biome, `tsc --noEmit`, and the Vitest suites)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the behavior changed
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, `.env.example`, `README.md`) if this changes setup, configuration, or the API
- [ ] Every locale in `messages/` updated, not just `en.json` (see [CONTRIBUTING.md § Adding a language](../CONTRIBUTING.md#adding-a-language))
- [ ] Screenshots attached, for a UI change
- [ ] The PR title (or commit message, for a single-commit PR) follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
